items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: All of us. Percy and Earl.

ctx.x: Ah, yeah. Did you play the bass with a bow?

Yes, with a bow. Three string bass. Three string. I think it was a G, D, and A spread. And he keep putting in the Killing Melody Black plan. That's the first book. He had all kinds of orchestration music. He taught all his grandsons. He was all happy to say. You studied with your grandfather then, Willis? All of us. Percy and Earl.
Yeah, I helped Percy too. Percy was playing drums. You know he was playing trumpet? Yeah, he started on drums.
